thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: org=ravencrest spike detected. 5xx/429 burst on inference-edge in us-west1. Alerting SLO owner and starting mitigation playbook.

oncall-lina: I'm on it. jumping in — Lina (on-call). First context: Ravencrest prod (org_id: org_rvn_81). Seeing 429s across text-gen endpoints, qps up ~7x vs baseline.

sre-oliver: Logs from edge: `429_over_limit` counters: 2023-03-18T14:02Z +1200, 14:05Z +3100. KV-cache hit rate unchanged. Latency normal until rate-limit kicks. Looks like a sudden client-side burst rather than model overload.

eng-james: Confirmed from tracing: user sessions sending many short chat calls with streaming disabled, so no long-lived connections. We'll likely mitigate with per-org burst allowance + short grace window.

oncall-lina: Quick decision options: 1) emergency org-level rate bump (temporary) 2) enable org-level queuing/pacing 3) disable nonessential endpoints (embeddings for Ravencrest) 4) ask CS to ask customer to reduce fan-out. Thoughts?

acct-maya: I'm on the line with Ravencrest. They say they're running a flash campaign and don't have backoff in client. They're OK with a short-term bump if it reduces errors for paying customers.

prod-tessa: Priority is minimizing customer visible 429s while keeping platform stable. I prefer temporary bump + pacing rather than cutting features.

oncall-lina: Action plan: do 15-minute emergency bump to per-org rate limit x3 and enable org pacing at token-level queue. If error rate doesn't drop in 5m, escalate to disabling embeddings for that org. I'll run the admin change now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting config change: /admin/orgs/org_rvn_81/policies (dry-run)

eng-james: Command I'm running from admin bastion:```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.local/api/orgs/org_rvn_81/policies" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_rate_multiplier":3,"temp_ttl_sec":900,"enable_pacing":true}'
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: config-change applied (txn 0x7f3a). Rolling forward in control plane. :white_check_mark:

oncall-lina: Applied. Monitoring metrics now. Live dashboard: https://console.redwood.local/orgs/org_rvn_81/traffic

sre-oliver: Early signs: 429s dropped by ~70% in first 90s. QPS stabilized at higher level but error signal reduced. No increase in 5xx.

acct-maya: Ravencrest confirmed better UX, watching their client backoff metrics. They're going to throttle their campaign within 10 min.

eng-james: Note for postmortem: add org_id to per-org rate audit logs; we had to correlate owner mapping manually which slowed decision by ~3m.

prod-tessa: Communication: Maya, please send a short note to Ravencrest support + CSM summarizing change and TTL, and ask for confirm when they reduce fan-out. I'll draft.

acct-maya: Will do. Draft: "We've applied a temporary throughput increase for 15 minutes to reduce 429s while you adjust client-side throttling. Pls confirm when your campaign is wound down"

oncall-lina: Planned rollback: TTL == 900s. If Ravencrest confirms manual throttle before TTL, we'll manually revert to baseline. If traffic persists after TTL, escalate to infra lead to consider longer adjustments or capacity move.

eng-james: Also running quick policy change to log extra fields for 1h: request.client_user_agent and request.batch_size to help diagnostics.

ops-bot: system: alert suppression for this org created to avoid paging for same symptom during mitigation window.

oncall-lina: Leaving runbook check: playbook step 3 (org-bump) completed. Marking P0 -> P1 if stable for next 10m.

sre-oliver: Adding note: recommend adding a small backlog quota per-org to absorb short bursts rather than full rate multiplier; follow-up task for Runtime to ship.

prod-tessa: Great. After TTL, we'll verify with Ravencrest and close. If any regression, reopen.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident thread updated: mitigation applied, TTL 15m, owner=oncall-lina, impact=partial (429s reduced).

oncall-lina: I'll stay watch for the next 20m. Ping me if 429 > 10% of baseline.

acct-maya: Ravencrest just sent: "thank you, errors dropped, we'll wind down now" — passing to you, Lina.

oncall-lina: Nice. Scheduling follow-up retro with Runtime + Eng + CS to decide long-term: org-specific pacing or auto-backoff suggestions. Closing thread in 25m if stable. :thumbsup:
